summary: Steep suburban kerb with houses 9-12 m away along its length.

best_section.where: West kerb of Hillsdon Road near the northern end

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11-20 m from the kerb on the same side along the whole stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, so a van can pull in, but the road is steep.
drivers.traffic: Bus route and through traffic; buses visible in imagery.
drivers.convention: Residential parking, but no sign of anyone staying overnight.

sun_shade: Mixed street-tree shade; houses shade the west side in the afternoon.
